preRegisteredBefore: first Actions run of scripts/quant/corporate-action-v2/audit-v2.mjs; fixed before any v2 result on real data was seen
purpose: Independent false-positive / false-negative control for the canonical corporate-action contract 2.0.0 (review R1/R13). Not drawn from the known V4 population.

selection.universe: all segments of the canonical capture that reproduces freeze V4-beae51ae1b07768b (same source objects)
excludedAsInSample: every segment with a security-month in the V4 extreme population (all 2213 extreme security-months, of which the 83 diagnostic cases are a subset)
every segment among the 74 adjusted-level > 1e6 securities
every segment on which canonical-total-return-1.2.0 places a SPLIT_SUSPECTED_UNDECLARED or PRICE_SPIKE_REVERTED hold (the population on which 1.1.0 -> 1.2.0 was revised)

categories.VOLATILE: top decile of the standard deviation of daily raw log returns (days without a provider event), median raw close >= 1
categories.HIGH_BETA_MOVE: at least one session with raw close/close >= 1.5 or <= 1/1.5 and no provider event that day
categories.STALE: at least 10 consecutive sessions with an identical raw close
categories.MERGER: delisted segment with delisting class ACQUISITION or MERGER_FORM (R15 SEC classification)
categories.BANKRUPTCY_DISTRESS: delisted segment with delisting class DEREGISTRATION_WITH_DISTRESS
categories.SYMBOL_CHANGE: segment whose issuer CIK has another segment with a different ticker starting within 30 days after this segment ends
categories.REVERSE_SPLIT_CONFIRMED: event category: SEC EFFECTIVE reverse split (newPerOld <= 1/2) of an eligible segment's CIK whose anchor date lies inside the segment; label = the SEC filing, independent of the price signature

labels.intervention: a v2 HOLD/QUARANTINE whose evidence class is PRICE_DISCONTINUITY_NO_CA_EVIDENCE, PROBABLE_CORPORATE_ACTION or CONFLICTING_CORPORATE_ACTION, or a v2 NORMALIZE
labels.TRUE_POSITIVE: an SEC split statement of any stage (8-K/6-K event or reverse-split proxy) for the segment's CIK dated within 365 days of the intervention date, or SEC shares outstanding that change by a factor of at least 1.5 (either direction) between the last report before and the first report on or after the intervention date
labels.FALSE_POSITIVE: segment has an issuer CIK, no SEC split statement of any stage within 365 days, and SEC shares outstanding do not change by a factor of 1.5 across the date
labels.UNLABELED: segment without issuer CIK (counted, not in the FP denominator)
labels.FALSE_NEGATIVE: REVERSE_SPLIT_CONFIRMED event whose session lies inside the v2 valid range and whose canonical gross total return on that session still carries the split: |ln g| > |ln q| / 2

acceptance.falsePositiveRatePooled: <= 0.02 of labelled control segments (all categories except REVERSE_SPLIT_CONFIRMED)
acceptance.intervals: Wilson 95 % reported with every rate; acceptance on the point estimate
acceptance.noTuning: no threshold, window or tolerance of sec-corporate-actions.js, corporate-action-validation.js, canonical-price-validity.js or canonical-total-return.js is changed after this run; a failed acceptance is reported as NOT_READY
